summary: Redesign and rebuild the marketing site on a modern static stack, improving load time and making content edits self-service for the Nova Studio team.
scope: Audit current site and define information architecture
Design 6 page templates (home, about, services, case studies, blog, contact)
Build with a static site generator, connected to a headless CMS
Basic SEO setup (meta tags, sitemap, redirects from old URLs)
timeline: 4 weeks from signed proposal and 50% deposit: 1 week design, 2 weeks build, 1 week migration/QA.
terms: 50% deposit to start, 50% due on launch. Proposal valid for 30 days. Up to 2 rounds of revisions per template included; additional rounds billed hourly.
notes: Hosting and CMS subscription costs are separate and billed directly to the client.
